title: South Africa
overview_paragraphs:
This trip covers South Africa from coast to bushveld: Cape Town’s mountain and peninsula, the Garden Route lagoon at Knysna, ostrich country around Oudtshoorn, the resort city of Sun City, and a safari in Kruger National Park, with a flight linking the south coast to Johannesburg.

Best for travelers who want city sightseeing, scenic coastline, and a Big 5 safari in a single trip, with Indian meals throughout.

places.name: Cape Town
places.tagline: A city folded around Table Mountain and two oceans
places.modal_tagline: WHERE THE TRIP BEGINS AT THE EDGE OF AFRICA
places.desc: Cape Town opens with a city tour through Clifton, Bo-Kaap, and Greenmarket Square, a cable car ride up Table Mountain, and an afternoon at the V&A Waterfront. A full-day peninsula tour follows, with a Seal Island cruise from Hout Bay, the Cape of Good Hope, the funicular to the old lighthouse, and the penguin colony at Boulders Beach.

places.name: Knysna
places.tagline: A tidal lagoon guarded by two sandstone cliffs
places.desc: Knysna sits on a large lagoon opening to the sea between the sandstone Heads, explored here on an evening cruise past forests, marshes, and unspoiled beaches.

places.name: Oudtshoorn
places.tagline: The feather capital of the world, with caves beneath it
places.modal_tagline: A DAY TRIP INTO OSTRICH COUNTRY
places.desc: Oudtshoorn is reached as a day trip from Knysna, with the Cango Caves’ underground limestone formations, a working ostrich farm, and a wildlife ranch with a crocodile park, where you can also have your photo taken with a cheetah.

places.name: Sun City
places.tagline: A resort city with a wave pool, golf courses, and a casino
places.modal_tagline: TWO DAYS OFF THE SIGHTSEEING CLOCK
places.desc: Sun City is a full resort complex built around a man-made lake, two championship golf courses, the Valley of the Waves water park, and the gardens of the Lost City. One day is left free to relax, with optional hot air ballooning available.

places.name: Kruger National Park
places.tagline: One of Africa’s largest reserves, and home to the Big 5
places.modal_tagline: THE SAFARI AT THE HEART OF THE TRIP
places.desc: Kruger fills a full day with morning and afternoon game drives, with lunch inside the park. Elephant, giraffe, zebra, buffalo, lion, hippo, and hyena are all commonly seen, with leopard, cheetah, wild dog, and rhino among the rarer sightings

places.name: Johannesburg
places.tagline: South Africa’s largest city, closing out the trip
places.desc: Johannesburg serves as the trip’s transit hub, connecting the south coast flight to Sun City on arrival and closing the trip with an overnight stay before the flight home.

inclusions: Table Mountain cable car & Peninsula tour
